title: 106th Rescue Wing Conducts MARE
description: Package of the 106th Rescue Wing conducting a Major Accident Response Exercise (MARE) at Westhampton Beach, N.Y., which included many different sections of the 106th as well as civilian agencies from around the area. Produced by Staff Sgt. David J. Murphy. Also available in high definition.
keywords: casualities, Major Accident Response Exercise, MARE, 106th Rescue Wing, Westhampton Beach, mock causalities, High Definition, HD, NY

transcript.text: Members of the 106 Civil Engineering Squadron, 106 Security Forces Squadron, and 106 Maintenance
Group worked with civilian agencies such as the West Hampton Beach Volunteer Ambulance
and Fire Department, as well as the Suffolk County Police Aviation Unit, in a training
event known as the Major Accident Response Exercise, or MARE.
The MARE took place at F.S. Grubeski Air National Guard Base on May 20, 2010.
The purpose of the MARE was to give all members involved a chance to respond to a Level A accident,
an accident involving a single helicopter crash with a small crew.
Level A requires the least amount of response personnel.
